data.body:
Approved refinement applied after auditing current parsers and maintained-project prior art. RP-05 now requires one side-effect-free stdlib argparse factory per command grammar; execution and generation use the same factory. Generated package-help/overview bytes remain committed and runtime-authoritative so help stays pre-operation and no-extras. The CLI reference consumes those artifacts; curated prose/examples remain editorial and may not define unchecked usage/option tables.

S2 was decomposed because the prior hand-written-help scope was too large for one reviewable leaf:
- `tremendous-comely-blesbok` (S2a): parser/route foundation and shadow parity.
- `fancy-felonious-ant` (S2b): core command parser migration.
- `groundable-expectable-grackle` (S2c): advanced/nested parser migration.
- `ammonitoid-senile-nighthawk` (S2d): deterministic artifact generation and pre-operation help cutover.

S2b/S2c depend on S2a; S2d depends on both. Existing S3/S4 still depend on the S2 container, so no execution/capability cutover can precede the complete parser/help contract. S1, S3, S5, S6, epic file impact, and verification plans were updated. Research is durable on `rubellite-secondary-cub`; no production/tracked file changed and no blocked plan review was forced.
